description: Unit (licensing): with a registered loader returning a sellable context and no ALS store, isCoManagedPurchaseSurfaceOpen is true; with the same loader inside runWithBillingCatalogContext it is also true (same answer with and without a wrapper)

Unit (licensing): with a registered loader that throws or returns unconfigured, the surface is closed even when STRIPE_CO_MANAGED_USER_PRICE_ID is set; with no loader registered, the env var alone opens it (CE behaviour preserved)

Unit (licensing): within one request the loader is called once across repeated gate checks, and a second request calls it again (no cross-request cache, so a set-account change is visible on the next request)

DB-backed integration (EE): migrated schema, env price/account unset, stripe_offer_catalog_settings + a current stripe_offer_versions row, eligible hosted Pro sponsor with an active base subscription and no trial: getSeatTrialOfferAction returns canStart, admits('co-managed-seat') is admitted, and prepareCoManagedSeatTrialAction creates a pending trial; with the settings row removed and no versions, the trial offer is null and intake refuses
Contract test: every EE entry point and the Temporal worker bootstrap import surfaceProbe (fails if a new entry reaches the gate without registering the loader)
Unit (EE): a catalog failure inside loadBillingCatalogContext emits one log line with the error code and returns an unsellable context; a second identical failure does not log again
